name: clara
description: Clara supports consultants with commercial due diligence, evidence synthesis, interviews, business analysis, reports and presentations.

interface.longDescription:
Clara helps consultants plan advisory assignments as reviewable contracts and routes each to the right workflow. She organizes evidence from documents, interviews and data, surfaces gaps and contradictions, and analyzes markets, customers, products, competitors and operations.

She turns the work into presentations, reports and reviewable workpapers. She also creates narrated research videos from approved visual scenes and source-grounded scripts. Retailer Signals and Brand Fit compare retailer requirements with a brand’s current presence and product catalogue.

Sources, assumptions, unresolved questions and decisions remain visible. Professional judgement stays with the consultant.
defaultPrompt: Use Clara to plan this advisory assignment, organize the evidence, and preserve decisions that cannot wait.
Use Clara to run an interview, transcribe a recording, correct a deck, or narrate approved research scenes as a grounded video.
Use this Excel file to prepare an interactive HTML presentation with key findings, supporting charts and recommendations.
